description: Starts rendering a workout as one full-length video with voice-over, in a chosen language. Use when the user wants a downloadable or shareable video of a whole workout. Not for short social clips (use generate_clips). Returns a progress card that updates until the video is ready. Downloading the finished file in Teams counts toward the monthly download quota.

force_new.description: true = render again from scratch, e.g. after a failed render or an edit. Defaults to false (reuse a matching render).

id.description: ID of the workout to render. Get it from list_team_workouts.

locale.description: Language of the voice-over and on-screen text, e.g. "en-US" or "de-DE". Omit for the team default.

name: export_workout_video
title: Export full workout video
